#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll mod = 998244353;
vector<ll> fac;

ll fastpow(ll n, ll ti) {
    ll result = 1;
    ll base = n % mod;
    while (ti > 0) {
        if (ti & 1) {
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        }
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        ti >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

ll ncr(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k) return 0;
    ll num = fac[n];
    ll den = (fac[n - k] * fac[k]) % mod;
    ll ans = (num * fastpow(den, mod - 2)) % mod;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    fac.resize(200001);
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < (int)fac.size(); i++) {
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % mod;
    }

    int n;
    ll k;
    scanf("%d %lld", &n, &k);

    if (k >= n) {
        printf("0\n");
        fflush(stdout);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        printf("%lld\n", fac[n]);
        fflush(stdout);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == n - 1) {
        printf("%d\n", 2 * n);
        fflush(stdout);
        return 0;
    }

    int filledCols = (int)(n - k);
    ll waysToChooseFilledCols = ncr(n, filledCols);
    ll ans = 0;

    for (int emptyCols = 0; emptyCols <= filledCols; emptyCols++) {
        ll waysToChoose = ncr(filledCols, emptyCols);
        ll waysToFill = fastpow(filledCols - emptyCols, (ll)n);
        ll val = (waysToChoose * waysToFill) % mod;
        if (emptyCols % 2 == 1) {
            val = -val;
        }
        ans = (ans + val + mod) % mod;
    }

    ans = (ans * waysToChooseFilledCols) % mod;
    ans = (ans * 2) % mod;

    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
